title: The Siege of Vienna
description: September-October 1529. Suleiman the Magnificent's army arrives before Vienna's medieval walls. The player commands the garrison of German Landsknechts and Spanish arquebusiers under Niklas Graf Salm: countermine the Ottoman sappers, repel assaults on the Carinthian Gate, and hold until autumn rains and supply failure force the Ottoman withdrawal.

anachronisms_found: FREDERICK_BARBAROSSA stands in for Niklas Graf Salm: a Hohenstaufen emperor who died in 1190, roughly 340 years before the siege and not a defender of Vienna
SALADIN represents Suleiman the Magnificent: a 12th-century Ayyubid sultan, wrong dynasty, wrong century, wrong theatre entirely

No Janissaries or Hand Cannoneers anywhere despite the text naming janissaries and Spanish arquebusiers; the engine's Turkish Janissary and generic Hand Cannoneer were both available and were avoidably omitted
CAMEL_RIDER x5 in the Ottoman siege lines outside Vienna: the Sipahi cavalry named in the dialogue were horsemen, and camels have no place on the Austrian Danube plain

KNIGHT x4 and MAN_AT_ARMS x4 as the Viennese garrison: mounted knights and mail-clad men-at-arms instead of the Landsknecht pike blocks the text describes (the Teutonic LANDSKNECHT unit exists in the engine and was not used)
TREBUCHET and MANGONEL as the Ottoman siege train in 1529, when the Sultan's force relied on gunpowder artillery and mines; only the defenders were given BOMBARD_CANNON
CROSSBOWMAN and SKIRMISHER as tower garrison rather than gunpowder infantry, contradicting the stated 'arquebusiers to the towers'
